answer_1.quote: We create T5-generated definition (T5Def) embeddings. We generate definitions using a FLAN-T5 Base (250M parameters) model developed by which was fine-tuned on datasets of English definitions and usage examples. We prompt the model with the same template as it was trained on: '[SENTENCE] What is the definition of [TERM]?'.

answer_2.quote: An evaluation of T5-generated definitions compared to Wiktionary definitions showed a very low SacreBLEU score of 3.822
